reviews.title: My dad has the fastest gaming computer now with this
reviews.comment:
Built my boomer dad a new pc, used this ram. It totally is getting him all the frames.
It's fine ram and was pretty cheap. Didn't have any issues with XMP profile.
reviews.author: Matthew M.

reviews.title: Pretty stable in dad's build, no complaints!
reviews.comment: Needed something on the QVL for my father's system, and these fit the bill while being on sale when I bought them! Haven't heard any stability complaints from dad's end, and he can still open as many chrome tabs as his heart desires.
reviews.author: engineezy

reviews.title: Doesn't work as expected!
reviews.comment:
The RAM produces errors at the manufacturer's stated frequency of 6400MHz, updating the BIOS, changing the power supply, changing the timings did not help.
It was possible to get stable operation only at 6200MHz (32-38-38-77) or lower.
reviews.author: virus23pl

reviews.title: likely a-die
reviews.comment: DRAM Stepping showing N/A in HWiNFO, but is stable at 130ns tRFC, which makes it more likely to be a-die, since m-die usually bottoms out around 150ns
reviews.author: CGCYMTXZHZ
